data.name: Professor's Assistant
data.description: You assist a professor of your choice in teaching her classes. You are now specialized in Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft, and can recruit a student to aid you in research when you use the academy library, which increases the circumstance bonus you gain from library access to +4.
